title: Files Write Scope
description: Renders the smallest candidate bounded write scope and explicit exclusions for a later G2 execution envelope. This node only derives candidate scope; it never grants write/merge/deploy authority.
intent: Render the smallest candidate future write set and explicit exclusions for a later G2 execution envelope.
outcome: Deterministic candidate write-scope evidence with bounded write paths, prohibited targets, excluded actions, and reason codes.
constraints: Write scope must be repo-relative and bounded to approved task files only.
Write scope must exclude protected-branch, merge, deploy, release, credential, migration, and production-data actions.
Write scope must fail closed when the candidate write set is empty, ambiguous, or includes a prohibited target.
exclusions: Force push, branch deletion, or PR base changes.
Merge, auto-merge, deploy, release, production config, credentials, secrets, migration, and production data.

reason_codes.ACCEPTED: Required candidate write scope rendered successfully.
reason_codes.EMPTY_SCOPE: No bounded write paths were available for the task.
reason_codes.PROHIBITED_ACTION: Candidate write scope includes a prohibited action or target.
reason_codes.MALFORMED_INPUT: Write scope inputs are invalid or ambiguous.
reason_codes.SCOPE_DRIFT: Requested write scope exceeds the bounded task envelope or has drifted from verified sources.
